title: Clearer Changes save feedback
summary: The Confirm step now presents saving, conflicts, offline guidance and successful sharing in a readable status surface.
changes: Saving and successful sharing have clear status labels in the Confirm step.
Offline guidance, conflicts and errors remain visible next to the confirmation action with explicit next steps.
The plain live message remains available if the optional presentation component cannot load.
Existing validation, shared writes, retry and deliberate PWA update approval remain unchanged.
